action.recommendation: Outside the NCCP ECOG eligibility range; review suitability.

explanation: Outside the NCCP ECOG eligibility range; review suitability.

action.recommendation: Known hypersensitivity is an NCCP exclusion.

explanation: Known hypersensitivity is an NCCP exclusion.

action.recommendation: Pregnancy or breastfeeding requires specialist review; do not give routine treatment clearance. Follow the medicine-specific pregnancy, contraception and breastfeeding precautions.

explanation: Pregnancy or breastfeeding requires specialist review; do not give routine treatment clearance. Follow the medicine-specific pregnancy, contraception and breastfeeding precautions.

action.recommendation: Colorectal cetuximab requires validated extended RAS wild-type status. KRAS exon 2 alone is not sufficient.

explanation: Colorectal cetuximab requires validated extended RAS wild-type status. KRAS exon 2 alone is not sufficient.

action.recommendation: Hold cetuximab for severe skin toxicity; source allows a maximum two-week interruption and requires recovery to grade ≤2 before restart.

explanation: Hold cetuximab for severe skin toxicity; source allows a maximum two-week interruption and requires recovery to grade ≤2 before restart.

action.recommendation: Discontinue cetuximab after the fourth severe skin episode.

explanation: Discontinue cetuximab after the fourth severe skin episode.

action.recommendation: Discontinue / obtain urgent specialist confirmation when severe skin toxicity has not resolved within the permitted interruption; do not automatically restart.

explanation: Discontinue / obtain urgent specialist confirmation when severe skin toxicity has not resolved within the permitted interruption; do not automatically restart.

action.recommendation: After the documented severe episode recovers within two weeks, source cetuximab restart dose is 250 mg/m². Confirm prior individual reductions; this is not a re-loading dose.

explanation: After the documented severe episode recovers within two weeks, source cetuximab restart dose is 250 mg/m². Confirm prior individual reductions; this is not a re-loading dose.

action.recommendation: After the documented severe episode recovers within two weeks, source cetuximab restart dose is 200 mg/m². Confirm prior individual reductions; this is not a re-loading dose.

explanation: After the documented severe episode recovers within two weeks, source cetuximab restart dose is 200 mg/m². Confirm prior individual reductions; this is not a re-loading dose.

action.recommendation: After the documented severe episode recovers within two weeks, source cetuximab restart dose is 150 mg/m². Confirm prior individual reductions; this is not a re-loading dose.

explanation: After the documented severe episode recovers within two weeks, source cetuximab restart dose is 150 mg/m². Confirm prior individual reductions; this is not a re-loading dose.

action.recommendation: Slow cetuximab infusion and monitor closely; follow acute reaction policy.

explanation: Slow cetuximab infusion and monitor closely; follow acute reaction policy.

action.recommendation: Slow cetuximab infusion and immediately treat symptoms; specialist assessment before continuation.

explanation: Slow cetuximab infusion and immediately treat symptoms; specialist assessment before continuation.

action.recommendation: Stop cetuximab immediately, treat the reaction and contraindicate further cetuximab.

explanation: Stop cetuximab immediately, treat the reaction and contraindicate further cetuximab.

action.recommendation: Interrupt the first infusion for a reaction within 15 minutes irrespective of grade. Assess benefit/risk and IgE-related risk before any resumption.

explanation: Interrupt the first infusion for a reaction within 15 minutes irrespective of grade. Assess benefit/risk and IgE-related risk before any resumption.

action.recommendation: Discontinue cetuximab for confirmed interstitial lung disease.

explanation: Discontinue cetuximab for confirmed interstitial lung disease.

action.recommendation: Interrupt implicated treatment and urgently investigate unexplained respiratory symptoms.

explanation: Interrupt implicated treatment and urgently investigate unexplained respiratory symptoms.

action.recommendation: Prompt ophthalmology assessment for possible keratitis; assess continuation versus interruption.

explanation: Prompt ophthalmology assessment for possible keratitis; assess continuation versus interruption.

action.recommendation: Correct magnesium, calcium and potassium as indicated. No numeric cetuximab hold threshold is specified; use clinical assessment.

explanation: Correct magnesium, calcium and potassium as indicated. No numeric cetuximab hold threshold is specified; use clinical assessment.

action.recommendation: Urgent assessment and treatment of fever / active infection; defer chemotherapy pending review.

explanation: Urgent assessment and treatment of fever / active infection; defer chemotherapy pending review.

action.recommendation: Hold chemotherapy for ANC <1.5 ×10⁹/L; repeat counts and assess recovery and nadir before restart.

explanation: Hold chemotherapy for ANC <1.5 ×10⁹/L; repeat counts and assess recovery and nadir before restart.

action.recommendation: Hold chemotherapy for platelets <75 ×10⁹/L; assess recovery before restart.

explanation: Hold chemotherapy for platelets <75 ×10⁹/L; assess recovery before restart.

action.recommendation: After count recovery, source irinotecan restart dose 150 mg/m²; cetuximab is maintained if otherwise suitable. Confirm previous dose and do not escalate an already lower dose.

explanation: After count recovery, source irinotecan restart dose 150 mg/m²; cetuximab is maintained if otherwise suitable. Confirm previous dose and do not escalate an already lower dose.

action.recommendation: After count recovery, source irinotecan restart dose 120 mg/m²; cetuximab is maintained if otherwise suitable. Confirm previous dose and do not escalate an already lower dose.

explanation: After count recovery, source irinotecan restart dose 120 mg/m²; cetuximab is maintained if otherwise suitable. Confirm previous dose and do not escalate an already lower dose.

action.recommendation: Discontinue irinotecan for ANC <0.5 after two weeks. Cetuximab continuation requires oncologist discretion and absence of progression.

explanation: Discontinue irinotecan for ANC <0.5 after two weeks. Cetuximab continuation requires oncologist discretion and absence of progression.

action.recommendation: Irinotecan is contraindicated above bilirubin 3 ×ULN.

explanation: Irinotecan is contraindicated above bilirubin 3 ×ULN.

action.recommendation: Bowel obstruction / chronic bowel disease is an irinotecan exclusion.

explanation: Bowel obstruction / chronic bowel disease is an irinotecan exclusion.

action.recommendation: Severe bone marrow failure excludes irinotecan treatment.

explanation: Severe bone marrow failure excludes irinotecan treatment.

action.recommendation: Immediate clinical assessment; atropine according to NCCP and local policy after checking contraindications. Distinguish this from delayed diarrhoea.

explanation: Immediate clinical assessment; atropine according to NCCP and local policy after checking contraindications. Distinguish this from delayed diarrhoea.

action.recommendation: Consider reduced irinotecan starting dose and enhanced toxicity monitoring; no fixed source percentage.

explanation: Consider reduced irinotecan starting dose and enhanced toxicity monitoring; no fixed source percentage.

action.recommendation: Treatment-related diarrhoea must be fully resolved before irinotecan; assess hydration, infection and bowel baseline.

explanation: Treatment-related diarrhoea must be fully resolved before irinotecan; assess hydration, infection and bowel baseline.

action.recommendation: Allow treatment-related adverse events to recover to grade 0–1 before irinotecan.

explanation: Allow treatment-related adverse events to recover to grade 0–1 before irinotecan.

action.recommendation: NCCP suggests irinotecan 50–66% of original dose at CrCl <10 or dialysis, with escalation if tolerated. Consultant/pharmacy must choose within the range.

action.recommendation: The regimen does not quantify an irinotecan dose for this bilirubin band; obtain consultant/pharmacy review.

action.recommendation: Discontinue irinotecan if diarrhoea remains above grade 2 for more than two weeks.

explanation: Discontinue irinotecan if diarrhoea remains above grade 2 for more than two weeks.
